Harper: quick follow-up — we've been seeing high scatter IO from offload because allocator places tiny pages across many slabs. idea: allocator can emit "coalesce_hints" per allocation so offload can group physically-adjacent pages.

Noel: interesting. you mean a hint in the page descriptor indicating preferred buddy-run? that could let coalescer prefer contiguous ranges.

Rina: warning: changing allocator layout affects fragmentation and hotness. we should offer hinting as advisory only, not guarantee. allocator could bias for ephemeral classes only.

Harper: agreed. sketch: allocator exposes hint bit + locality_group id. offload/coalesce uses locality_group to form contiguous batches. fallback: if group too sparse, revert to existing behavior.

Kai: plus: add an API for allocator to request small compaction windows when tenant burst is low. compaction could be async and limited CPU budget.

Noel: metrics to add: locality_group_coalesce_hits, hint_adoption_ratio, scatter_io_reduction_pct. tags: pool_id, tenant_id.

Rina: safe rollout: feature-flag allocator hints; canary on ephemeral pools first. rollback if fragmentation worsens >8% or p99 increases.

infra-bot: canary scheduled: alloc-hints-canary-2026-05-02 01:00 UTC  job 4242.

Harper: I'll open RFC PR with examples and default limits. thanks — follow-up in PR. :thumbsup:
